prompt:
Create one original Hearts of Iron IV achievement emblem as an isolated painted object on a genuinely transparent square canvas. Shared set style: a compact dark charcoal medallion with an antique bronze rim and symmetrical raised bronze laurel branches, hand-painted game-icon relief with dark patina, warm metallic highlights and crisp high-contrast forms. One distinct central subject must be large and readable at 64x64; make the complete medallion-and-laurel object fill about 88 percent of the canvas, centered, with clear transparent margin on all sides. Use a restrained charcoal, bronze, brass and subject-specific physical color accent. This is one alpha-backed subject layer that will sit over an existing square achievement background. Keep the background genuinely transparent everywhere outside the emblem. Do not include any square or painted background, outer rectangular frame, extra border, second medallion, words, letters, numerals, flags, logos, watermark, red X, UI marks, unrelated objects, or checkerboard. No photorealistic Earth or photographic texture.

Inside the medal: a cracked physician's respirator mask with one leaking crimson-and-amber plague vial behind it, suggesting a returned weapon and a failed program; keep the mask and vial as one clearly readable focal group.

Style and edge requirements: paint this as a restrained hand-painted game emblem with broad, simple forms and only a few readable details; avoid photographic or glossy CGI realism, dense scenery, tiny hardware, excessive surface texture, and oversized bright-gold wreaths. Keep the shared laurel and rim dark bronze and visually secondary to the central subject. Use a crisp clean bronze silhouette edge only: absolutely no colored fringe, outline glow, halo, stray pixels, matte, or specks outside the badge. Leave at least five percent genuinely transparent margin on every side.
